data.body:
AC EVIDENCE, verified against merged main (Gerrit 2084, commit f4f35f7bfa).

AC1 uniqueness guard: tests/unit/test_run_request_builder.py::test_the_single_turn_structured_request_is_built_only_by_for_structured passes. The guard is self-testing - test_the_guard_catches_a_hand_built_site_and_a_reasoned_marker_excuses_it writes a synthetic hand-built site, confirms the guard FIRES, confirms a reasoned '# single-turn-structured-ok: vendored' marker EXCUSES it, and confirms a BARE reasonless marker still fires. That is the three-way mutation proof done in-test rather than by hand.
AC2 builder edge cases: same suite, 6 passed - for_structured without bounds and SingleTurnBounds with any field missing both raise TypeError.
AC3 site table: tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py, 13 passed - _EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES still lists all 24 sites with the same keys, config expressions and verdicts after adoption.

AC4 no assertion edits - HOLDS, with a nuance worth recording rather than ticking blindly. The landed tests/ delta is +25/-0, +194/-0, and +37/-4. The four deletions are all in test_subcall_class_selection.py's AST-scanning HELPER (calls_by_name, _ast_index(), a docstring, and a 'node.func.id != RunRequest' check), teaching the scanner to recognise RunRequest.for_structured(...) alongside RunRequest(...). No assertion was touched, and AC3 independently confirms the scanner still finds the same 24 sites with the same verdicts.

Separately fixed during review (recorded on the change): the RP-01 census in test_rp01_s5_authoritative_oracle.py asserts >=10 files construct structured requests, as a proxy for the census MECHANISM resolving computed and multi-line modes. It only recognised RunRequest(mode=...), so consolidating fourteen hand-built sites dropped it to 4 and failed on all four CI shards - it was measuring the SPELLING, not the property. Taught _scope_constructs_structured that reaching the builder is itself proof of a structured construction; the census now sees 11 files, so the >=10 threshold was left alone rather than lowered to fit.
